I submitted **"Example Domain"**, but that's the page's title, not a heading — the page doesn't show one. - **No heading on the page:** Neither the screen nor the accessibility tree has a heading element. The old example.com had `

Example Domain

`, but the current page shows only an icon, a notice paragraph in six languages and a "Learn more" link. The browser tab title is still "Example Domain," which is where my answer came from. If your check looks for an `

` on example.com, it will now find nothing. - **The page says not to use it this way:** Its notice reads: *"This is not a service; avoid relying on it for testing and monitoring purposes."* For a stable infrastructure check, a test page you control would be more reliable. The browser itself worked fine: the page loaded, scrolling worked, and the answer was submitted. I didn't visit any other websites.
